svg.title: How to read the NaOH–water enthalpy–concentration chart
svg.text: How to read the NaOH–water enthalpy–concentration chart
Isotherms of solution enthalpy (Btu/lb solution) vs concentration
Mark the concentration of the liquor on the bottom axis (here 30 % NaOH).
Go straight up to its temperature isotherm (here 160 °F; interpolate between printed lines).
Go across to the enthalpy axis. 4 Read H (here ≈ 115 Btu/lb solution).
Use the liquor’s actual temperature: the feed temperature for the feed, the boiling point (Dühring) for the liquor.
Redrawn from the printed chart (digitized); in the exam read the printed chart — values may differ slightly.
